map.点积和叉积区别？: What is the difference between the dot product and the cross product?
map.点积是标量，衡量「同向程度」（含夹角余弦）；叉积是向量，垂直两向量所在平面，大小: The dot product is a scalar measuring how aligned the vectors are (it includes the cosine of the angle); the cross product is a vector perpendicular to the plane of the two vectors, whose magnitude equals the parallelogram area, and is defined only in 3D.
map.点积为 0 说明什么？: What does a zero dot product mean?
map.两向量正交（垂直），或一个为零向量。几何上互不影响、投影为 0。: The two vectors are orthogonal (perpendicular), or one of them is the zero vector. Geometrically they do not affect each other and the projection is 0.
map.三维点积（数量积）：A·B = a_x×b_x + a_y×b_y + a_z×: 3D dot product (scalar product): A·B = a_x×b_x + a_y×b_y + a_z×b_z (the six components are multiplied pairwise and summed); related values: the chart gives the projection form A·B = |A|·cosθ and cosθ from |A| and the angle θ. Validation: no strict validation; empty components default to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; a dot product =0 means the vectors are orthogonal, >0 an acute angle, <0 an obtuse angle; the result keeps two decimals.
